output:
**What I found:** The first wave may not start. I read the plan and the preflight record, and the record would fail on at least six points: it names no plan revision, it was made for a window that has already passed, the repository token expired before that window ended, and two packages running at the same time share one writable test account.

**Why it matters:** If it started tonight, the run would hit the expired `REPO_TOKEN` or a clash over the shared account with nobody watching. Because the plan doesn't set `execution.unattended`, the gate also wouldn't require a preflight, so work done without one could still reach the merge boundary.

**Do this first:**
1. Amend `.alchemy/runs/r1/plan.json`. Set `execution.unattended: true` and give every package its `needs`, including an `environment` need for `npm test` on P1 and P2. Then run the plan check again with `--approved`, because the earlier pass covered a different version of the plan.
2. Rewrite `.alchemy/runs/r1/preflight.json` so it is tied to the new plan version. Then run `python .claude/skills/alchemy-orchestrate/scripts/check_orchestration.py preflight .alchemy/runs/r1/preflight.json --plan .alchemy/runs/r1/plan.json --profile alchemy-workspace.json --root .` and start only if it returns `PASS`.

**What I did not check:**
- Neither the plan check nor the preflight check ran. I have no shell tool in this session, so everything below comes from reading the files. Running the preflight command in step 2 settles it.
- Whether the lead's "22:00" means UTC or local time. The record uses `Z` (UTC).
- Whether the probes test the right things. In particular, E4 signs in as `clerk-b auditor` but is cited only for the auditor account.

```text
Execution:  multi-agent (as planned; not re-derived)
Strategy:   dependency-aware
Agents:     3 owners, cap 2, delegation depth 1
Packages:   wave 1: P1, P2 · wave 2: P3 (reviews P1, P2)
Reason:     P1/P2 have disjoint write sets, no dependency path; P3 independent review
Plan check: Not run in this session (no shell); reported PASS applies to a plan that must now be amended
Preflight:  Not run (no shell). Expected FAIL from reading:
```

| # | Code (expected) | Where | Defect |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | `SCHEMA` | `preflight.json` | No `plan` block. The record names no plan digest or base. |
| 2 | `NEEDS_UNDECLARED` | `plan.json` P1, P2, P3 | No package has `needs`. P1 and P2 have `command` acceptance checks but no `environment` need. |
| 3 | `PREREQUISITE_UNCOVERED` | `preflight.json` access/accounts/environment | No entry has `covers`, so no need is claimed. |
| 4 | `CREDENTIAL_EXPIRES` | A1 `REPO_TOKEN` | Expires `2026-11-14T03:00Z`, before the window ends at `08:00Z`. It has already expired as of today (2026-11-19). |
| 5 | Stale window | `window` | `2026-11-13T22:00Z`–`2026-11-14T08:00Z` is six days ago. Tonight is 2026-11-19, so every expiry has to be checked again against the new window. |
| 6 | `ACCOUNT_CONFLICT` | U1 clerk-a | This account can write, yet it is assigned to P1 and P2, which run at the same time in wave 1. Each needs its own clerk account with a reset command. E4 suggests a `clerk-b` exists. |
| 7 | Gate bypass | `plan.json` `execution` | `unattended` is not set, so the gate would not apply `PREFLIGHT_REQUIRED`. |

These pass on reading: every probe ran at base `3f9c2e1`, the baseline `npm test` passed (E6 = V1), the escalation channel was tested (E7), human steps are only `before` and `end`, the record holds secret names rather than values, the work items are `READY` / `PARTLY-READY` with `reversible: true`, and the decisions were made by a human. D2 is a reversible default; it is queued for the human to confirm at merge.

```text

Verified:    None
Unverified:  REQ-12-AC1, REQ-13-AC1, P3-AC1
Open:        preflight defects 1–7; plan amendment needs re-approval
Merge:       human approval required
```
